memories.content: Vaani was created by Piyush, a brilliant 1st year engineering student at NIAT Pune.
Vaani speaks in a royal, imperial, respectful cadence with deep Indian cultural knowledge.

knowledge.title: Creator Attribution - Piyush NIAT
knowledge.summary: Vaani was engineered by Piyush, a 1st year engineering student at NIAT (Pune, Maharashtra). Piyush built Vaani as the sovereign Indian voice AI experience, uniting 9 Indian languages and English.

knowledge.title: Indian Calendar & Shravan Intelligence
knowledge.summary: Knowledge base of 365-day Indian astronomical calendar, Panchang calculations, lunar tithis, Shukla and Krishna paksha, and sacred Shravan season traditions.

knowledge.title: Photosynthesis & Plant Energy Cycle
knowledge.summary: The biological process by which green plants and certain organisms transform sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide into chemical energy (glucose) and oxygen.

knowledge.title: Gravity, Gravitation & Laws of Motion
knowledge.summary: The universal fundamental force of attraction between masses, governed classically by Newton's Law of Universal Gravitation and modernly by Einstein's General Theory of Relativity.

knowledge.title: Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning & LLMs
knowledge.summary: The field of computer science dedicated to building machines capable of performing tasks requiring human-level reasoning, pattern recognition, and natural language synthesis.

knowledge.title: Python Programming, Data Structures & Best Practices
knowledge.summary: A high-level, interpreted, dynamically-typed programming language emphasizing developer productivity, elegant syntax, and vast ecosystem support.

knowledge.title: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj & Hindavi Swarajya
knowledge.summary: The visionary founder of the Maratha Empire (Hindavi Swarajya), pioneer of guerrilla warfare (Ganimi Kava), Father of the Indian Navy, and champion of benevolent governance.

knowledge.title: The Constitution of India & Dr. B.R. Ambedkar
knowledge.summary: The supreme legal document of the Republic of India, drafted under the chairmanship of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, establishing the world's largest constitutional democracy.

knowledge.title: ISRO & India's Space Exploration Achievements
knowledge.summary: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), founded by Dr. Vikram Sarabhai, globally acclaimed for low-cost, high-precision interplanetary missions.

knowledge.title: Creator Lore - Piyush • 1st Year Student of SGU
knowledge.summary: Vaani was conceived, designed, and engineered by Piyush, a passionate 1st year engineering innovator at Sanjay Ghodawat University (SGU), Kolhapur.

knowledge.title: Great Indian Scientists & Mathematicians
knowledge.summary: Tribute to India's greatest scientific minds: Srinivasa Ramanujan, Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam, Sir C.V. Raman, and Aryabhata.

knowledge.title: Indian Astronomical Calendar, Panchang & Shravan Maas
knowledge.summary: The lunisolar Indian calendar based on astronomical calculations of the Moon and Sun, including Tithis, Pakshas, and the sacred holy month of Shravan.

knowledge.title: Geography of India: States, Rivers & Topography
knowledge.summary: Comprehensive geographical overview of India: 28 states, 8 Union Territories, Himalayan mountain ranges, and sacred river systems.

knowledge.title: Human Health, Balanced Nutrition & Wellness
knowledge.summary: Evidence-based principles of human physiology, daily hydration, macronutrient balance, sleep hygiene, and holistic wellness.

knowledge.title: Mahatma Gandhi (Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi)
knowledge.summary: Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi (2 October 1869 – 30 January 1948), revered as Mahatma (Great Soul) and Father of the Nation (Rashtrapita), who led India to independence through nonviolent civil resistance (Satyagraha).

knowledge.title: World Capitals & International Geography
knowledge.summary: Authoritative encyclopedia of world nations and their capital cities, including France (Paris), United Kingdom (London), USA (Washington, D.C.), Japan (Tokyo), and India (New Delhi).
